notes.title: Check out my next game!
notes.content:
Thank you everyone that has played and enjoyed [i]Serious Sam DD XXL[/i]! 
I'd like to show you my next game that was just revealed. 
It is an action-platformer with a cool twist. 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/[/url]
[img]https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2976260/header.jpg?t=1718126766https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2976260/header.jpg?t=1718126766[/img]
[h2]Please [b]wishlist [/b][i][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/]ChainStaff[/url][/i] today! It's a big help to me, as it helps support me as I keep making new games.[/h2]

If you like:
[list]
[*] [i]Contra[/i]
[*] [i]Bionic Commando[/i]
[*] [i]Earthworm Jim[/i]
[*] Grappling hooks
[*] Freaky monsters
[*] Throwing giant spears
[*] Playing as a weird player character who is human but has an alien stuck to his head
[*] Crazy guns
[/list]
Then it's very likely you'll enjoy [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2976260/ChainStaff/]ChainStaff[/url]! 
It will hopefully be released some time in 2025.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26772782/9eacbea70d87f8895c7985aefb226fa88cb151bd.jpg[/img]
"I thank you for your support."
(For all the old-timers out there :D )
-Nathan
Mommy's Best Games
